notes: «جميعا عن أبي داود» then «قال ابن المثنى حدثنا سليمان بن داود»: the common shaykh is written as «أبي داود» and then, in the next clause, by the fuller form «سليمان بن داود». Written once in the fuller form, following the rule-7 pattern; the kunya itself is not identified.
«أنه سئل» is passive: no asker is named. «سمع أبا إياس» is a link (rule 5).
Anas speaks last: the saying is his answer.
